title: Piccolo: Co-Evolving Decision Models and Data through Recursive Self-Improvement
abstract: arXiv:2611.24651v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present Piccolo, a family of multimodal decision models (0.8B to 27B) that coevolves model capabilities and training data via Agentic Data Engineering and recursive self-improvement (RSI). The models predict probabilities over candidate answers for general-purpose text and visual judgments, agent harnesses, data workflows, and interactive games. Piccolo-27B tops the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard with a score of 75.59, while Piccolo-9B and Piccolo-4B achieve 68.35 and 67.46, respectively. All three rank first on the Private benchmark in their respective model-size categories. Research agents analyze model behavior, construct training data, conduct experiments, and use the results to refine subsequent proposals. Semantic slices and a shared research memory connect these actions across the model family's development. translated_title: Piccolo：通过递归自我改进实现决策模型与数据的协同演化
translated_abstract: 我们提出了Piccolo，这是一个多模态决策模型家族（参数规模从0.8B到27B），通过智能体数据工程和递归自我改进（RSI）实现模型能力与训练数据的协同演化。这些模型对通用文本与视觉判断、智能体框架、数据工作流和交互式游戏中的候选答案进行概率预测。Piccolo-27B以75.59的分数登顶Decision Index Vision Full排行榜，而Piccolo-9B和Piccolo-4B分别取得68.35和67.46的成绩，三者均在各自模型规模类别的Private基准测试中排名第一。研究智能体负责分析模型行为、构建训练数据、开展实验，并利用实验结果来改进后续方案。语义切片和共享研究记忆在整个模型家族的开发过程中将这些行动串联起来。借助包含数十万个样本的训练配方，数据选择和反馈驱动的改进……
tldr: Piccolo是一系列通过智能体数据工程与递归自我改进实现模型能力与训练数据协同演化的多模态决策模型，其中Piccolo-27B以75.59分登顶Decision Index Vision Full排行榜。
en_tdlr: Piccolo is a family of multimodal decision models that co-evolves model capabilities and training data through agentic data engineering and recursive self-improvement, with Piccolo-27B topping the Decision Index Vision Full leaderboard at 75.59.
